title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette and a table view to the Session 3 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 3 app shows the drag and no-drag paths in blue and grey, which some colour-blind users cannot separate.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette and line styles that stay distinguishable in grayscale, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Both paths distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: bounce and roll
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet: the ball stops at its first landing.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. A six needs no bounce, but fielding and a four do.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: crosswind in 3D
body:
## Problem
Session 3 is two-dimensional; a crosswind cannot be represented.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A 3D solver and an app view from above showing the sideways drift.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Roadmap checkpoint met (5.2 m drift, within 0.3 m)
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: the optimal-angle map
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a map of the best angle over speed and drag coefficient; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus a picture like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 546-point map in under 10 seconds
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
